summary: Full end-to-end test of RPP Studio (Indonesian teacher app). Backend: 11 pytest tests covering auth, documents CRUD, and AI generation — all pass (11/11 after fixing one email-case test assertion; backend actually behaves correctly by lowercasing emails). Frontend: verified login (guru@demo.com/guru123), dashboard with all generator buttons + stats + docs list, manual RPP create flow (form → save → viewer with Kop Sekolah/signature block A4 layout), dashboard list actions (view/print/delete testids present), profile page (save button present), AI Generator ATP flow (Gemini gemini-3.1-pro-preview returned 200 with well-formatted ATP table, editable-content shown, save creates doc + navigates to /view/:id), register new teacher via /register redirects to /dashboard. Delete flow removed the document (DELETE 200) and item disappeared. All data-testid attributes required by the review are present.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: backend sets allow_credentials=True together with allow_origins='*' (from env default). Not a functional bug for this JWT-in-Authorization flow (no cookies used), but per spec browsers will reject credentialed requests when origin is '*'. Consider setting explicit CORS_ORIGINS in .env.
server.py: /api/documents/stats route is registered BEFORE /api/documents/{doc_id} which is correct — good route ordering.
AI extract-rpp writes uploaded file to a NamedTemporaryFile then unlinks in finally — good. No _id leakage observed anywhere (verified in test responses).
Frontend AuthContext stores JWT in localStorage (matches design). Consider XSS hardening in the future but acceptable for MVP.
Delete uses window.confirm dialog — works, but consider a styled confirm modal for production polish.
No functional bugs found in the tested surface area.
test_credentials: guru@demo.com / guru123 (seeded). Also verified register flow with TEST_ui_*@example.com.
seed_data_creation: Test artifacts created during runs (RPP + ATP documents) were deleted at the end of the manual flow; a few TEST_ documents from pytest CRUD tests are cleaned up in-test. Some AI-generated docs may remain from the generator run — cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — safe to reuse. AI generate call is slow (10-40s), so use >90s timeouts. Upload-RPP flow via /api/ai/extract-rpp was NOT tested through the UI dropzone (would require a sample PDF), but the endpoint itself was pre-verified by main agent via curl. The frontend browser tool occasionally times out on `wait_for_load_state('networkidle')`; prefer `wait_for_selector` on a known testid instead.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional issues found. Note about UI test flakiness: `page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')` intermittently timed out in this environment (likely due to the __emergent_overlay__/report background request failing repeatedly). Fix: replaced with `wait_for_selector` on known data-testids; after that, every E2E flow (login/dashboard/RPP-create/viewer/list-actions/profile/AI generator ATP/save-doc/delete/register) passed.
